title: Rehearse handoff, retire delivered tasks, and prepare 0.3 RC

requirement.summary: Close the current development loop with installed-artifact evidence, remove delivered tasks from automatic discovery, and prepare a reviewable 0.3.0 release candidate.

objective.rationale: The runtime slice needs distribution-level proof and a clean next-task queue before its first 0.3 candidate can be reviewed honestly.

goal: Prove handoff and rollover from the exact wheel, pause all delivered historical tasks without claiming completion semantics, and prepare validated 0.3.0rc1 source and release notes.
non_goals: Do not claim independent human usability evidence from an agent-operated rehearsal.
Do not reinterpret paused as completed, accepted, merged, or released.
Do not promote 0.3.0rc1 to stable or migrate a consumer repository.
Do not weaken tests, compatibility checks, confirmation boundaries, or authority flags.
Do not publish, tag, or push unless the existing explicit human approval and GitHub authentication both remain valid.
acceptance_signals: A fresh environment installs the exact built wheel without source-path leakage and completes verified finish, Monitor, HANDOFF, zero/one/many rollover, and exact REPLACE checks in an independent Git repository.
The rehearsal records wheel identity, commands, outcomes, limitations, and unchanged authority boundaries.
All seventeen previously admitted delivered task contracts are paused with an explicit routing-hygiene rationale that does not claim semantic completion.
The 0.3.0rc1 package identity, bundled compatibility metadata, and release notes agree, while stable promotion remains out of scope.
Future release-candidate manifests inherit the reviewed supported-from versions from release/current.json instead of silently falling back to 0.1.0.
Focused tests, the complete suite, task and scope checks, repository governance, release-manifest validation, wheel inspection, and diff checks pass before any publication step.
Commit, push, RC tag, and GitHub Pre-release remain distinct observable actions and stop at any authentication or gate failure.

items: A source checkout could accidentally satisfy the rehearsal instead of the installed wheel.
Pausing delivered tasks could be misread as a completion record unless the rationale is explicit.
Release identity may drift between runtime, bundled metadata, wheel name, notes, and tag.
A publication step could partially succeed if authentication or a gate fails.

stop_conditions: Stop if the installed rehearsal imports AgentGov from the source checkout.
Stop if handoff or rollover mutates preserved session evidence or bypasses exact confirmation.
Stop if task hygiene requires inventing a completed decision state outside the task schema.
Stop before push, tag, or release if GitHub authentication is invalid or any required gate fails.
Stop before stable promotion or consumer migration.

decision.rationale: The user authorized the next automatic-product slice on 2026-08-06. This delivered RC closeout task is paused for routing hygiene only; the change does not claim new completion, acceptance, publication, stable promotion, or consumer migration evidence.
